Reuse of Rate and Interface for Other Customer Groups

1. You can copy a time-of-use interface (Create from Template) and change the consumption periods.

2.|n the rate facts, allocate the new interface to a different fact group (for example, Residential Customers South).

3. For the operands, enter the same result parameters as operand values.
